messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate detected for /v1/generate in us-west-2. 5xx spike + increased tail latency. Smart-routing fallback triggered repeatedly. Paging on-call.
alice: ack — I'm on call. looking at the dashboard now.
ben: i'm seeing a pattern: client retries are clustered at the edge, and our routing policy is fallback->region->variant which is causing repeated cross-region failovers. looks like failover is returning a 429/503 from target which triggers client retries -> more failovers.
carol: quick note: the model variant mapping for 'gptb-16q' in us-west-2 was accidentally marked incompatible with short-context requests after yesterday's rollout. fallback rule is sending traffic to eu-central-1 then to us-east-1.
eva: multiple customers reporting degraded throughput and 'rate limit exceeded' errors in console. Support receiving escalations from 3 paying customers (org ids redacted).
alice: are clients doing exponential backoff? I see many with default aggressive retry (3x immediate). that will amplify.
ben: capturing recent logs. snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T21:12:03Z] route: us-west-2 -> eu-central-1 fallback
[2026-03-15T21:12:03Z] backend: eu-central-1 returned 503
[2026-03-15T21:12:04Z] client-retry count=1 src=ip:10.8.4.33
[2026-03-15T21:12:04Z] route: us-west-2 -> eu-central-1 fallback (again)
```
carol: the policy has `allow_fallback_retries: true` which lets the router attempt multiple fallbacks per request. that's too aggressive for high-volume clients.
alice: immediate mitigation options:
- flip routing policy to prefer local variants and disable cross-region fallback
- rate-limit per-client retry window at the edge
- set Retry-After on 503s from backends
which can we do fastest?
carol: I can push a config change to disable cross-region fallback within 2 minutes: `routing.policies.smart_fallback.enabled = false` for the route. I'll prepare a patch.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: config-change routing-policy disable-cross-region-fallback by carol. CI checks passed.
ben: also suggest adding a temporary header rewrite for `X-Client-Retry-After: 1s` to cut client retry loops.
alice: do it. we'll communicate to support and prod teams.
carol: pushed rollback for fallback policy (ID: cfg-7731). propagation starting.
alice: I'm going to page product ops to review client SDK retry defaults. @nate can you loop in SDK team? customers are getting 5xxs.
nate: on it. will draft a quick note recommending exponential backoff with jitter and server-driven Retry-After honor.
eva: support message to customers: "We're investigating increased errors affecting generation endpoints. We've applied temporary routing changes to reduce cross-region failovers. We'll update as we know more." sending now.
ben: after the disable, error rate dropped ~70% within 90s. latency improved. still seeing bursts from a handful of IPs.
carol: added an emergency rule to circuit-break clients with >5 failed attempts in 10s. config id cfg-7732.
deploy-bot: Deploy success: cfg-7731, cfg-7732 applied to us-west-2 edge fleet.
alice: handing to ben for post-mitigation checks and RCA. I'm going offline for follow-ups in 30m.
ben: will run full impact assessment. early numbers:
- peak 5xx rate: 12% -> back to 2.5%
- affected requests: ~280k over 40m
- customers with escalations: 3 verified, 2 under investigation
carol: root cause: rollout change to variant compatibility + an overly permissive fallback policy + aggressive client retry defaults = amplified thundering herd across regions.
nate: action items:
- short: revert fallback policy and add server Retry-After behavior (done)
- mid: change default SDK retry behavior, docs update, add per-customer throttling knobs
- long: add smarter fallback that accounts for retry-imprint and client backoff headers
eva: will coordinate customer follow-up templates and SLO impact comms.
ben: creating incident ticket INC-2026-0315 and will attach logs + timeline.
alice: ++ please include exact config diffs and who approved emergency changes.
carol: adding policy snippet we changed for the RCA:
```
- smart_fallback:
    enabled: true
    allow_fallback_retries: true
+ smart_fallback:
    enabled: false
    allow_fallback_retries: false
```
ben: ETA for incident report: 4 hours. I'll include suggested monitoring knobs to detect this amplification pattern earlier (look for correlated retries + cross-region routing spikes).
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315 created and assigned to ben. Severity: Sev2. Paging schedule updated.
alice: thanks everyone. postmortem to follow with timeline, customer impact, and mitigation steps. :white_check_mark:
